scout_claims_text_check.name: scout_claims_text_check
scout_claims_text_check.value: char_length("scout_claims"."statement") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND char_length("scout_claims"."reason") <= 300 AND ("scout_claims"."attribute" IS NULL OR char_length("scout_claims"."attribute") <= 80) AND ("scout_claims"."value" IS NULL OR char_length("scout_claims"."value") <= 200)

scout_evidence_fields_check.name: scout_evidence_fields_check
scout_evidence_fields_check.value: ("scout_evidence"."attribute" IS NULL OR char_length("scout_evidence"."attribute") <= 80) AND ("scout_evidence"."value" IS NULL OR char_length("scout_evidence"."value") <= 200) AND ("scout_evidence"."model" IS NULL OR char_length("scout_evidence"."model") <= 120)

scout_sources_read_check.name: scout_sources_read_check
scout_sources_read_check.value: ("scout_sources"."outcome" = 'ok') = "scout_sources"."identified" AND ("scout_sources"."content_sha256" IS NULL OR "scout_sources"."retrieved_at" IS NOT NULL)

ticket_assets_kind_check.name: ticket_assets_kind_check
ticket_assets_kind_check.value:
("ticket_assets"."kind" = 'image' AND "ticket_assets"."mime_type" IN ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp') AND "ticket_assets"."duration_ms" IS NULL)
        OR ("ticket_assets"."kind" = 'video' AND "ticket_assets"."mime_type" = 'video/mp4' AND "ticket_assets"."duration_ms" IS NOT NULL)

worker_tasks_lease_check.name: worker_tasks_lease_check
worker_tasks_lease_check.value: ("worker_tasks"."status" = 'running') = ("worker_tasks"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_tasks"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
